# ankerl::unordered_dense

Vendored from https://github.com/martinus/unordered_dense, tag **v5.3.1**
(MIT, see `LICENSE`). Header-only; only `include/ankerl/unordered_dense.h` and
its companion `stl.h` are taken, unmodified.

Include as `#include <ankerl/unordered_dense.h>` (`third_party/ankerl` is on the
shared include path in `build_common.py`).

Not taken: `huge_page_allocator.h`, `mapped_view.h`, tests, benchmarks.
